description.value: Flour Dance Bakery is an artisan bakery in Richmond specializing in Asian-inspired breads and desserts, including matcha, taro, sesame, and lychee loaves made with premium hard spring flour and pure milk over 16-hour fermentation. The bakery operates both a retail storefront and an online ordering system with local delivery and self-pickup routes serving Richmond, Burnaby, and Vancouver. It is a bilingual (English and Chinese) business with a loyal community following, marketing itself as the 'Flour Dance Union.'

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 18m; rack at 67m; rack at 86m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Flour Dance Bakery is an active artisan bakery in Richmond selling Asian-style breads, loaves, and dessert items. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. Two different phone numbers appear on the website — 604-219-6806 consistently in the footer across all pages, and 604-401-5558 in the main body of the contact page — flagged as a concern. The OSM address (8300 Capstan Way) differs from the Richmond pickup/delivery address listed on the shipping page (8120 Westminster Hwy), suggesting either multiple locations or an address discrepancy that warrants flagging.
